content_html:
If you’ve already visited Machu Picchu, you probably discovered why it is one of the most impressive destinations in the world.

But you also discovered only a part of what Peru has to offer.

Many travelers believe that after visiting Machu Picchu they have already “seen Peru”…

The reality is that they have only seen the beginning.

Peru Has Much More to Offer Beyond Machu Picchu

Your second trip can be completely different.

More adventure
More culture
More nature
Less mass tourism

And the best part: Peru has incredible destinations for travelers who want to explore beyond the classics.

1. Lima, Paracas, and Huacachina: Coast, Gastronomy, and Adventure

If your first trip focused on Cusco, the Peruvian coast is your next great experience.

What you can enjoy:

  • Walk along the Miraflores boardwalk
  • Enjoy Peruvian gastronomy in Lima
  • Sail to the Ballestas Islands
  • Try sandboarding in Huacachina
  • Ride dune buggies through the desert

Ideal for travelers looking for variety and adventure.

2. Arequipa: The White City of Peru

One of the most beautiful and underrated cities in the country.

In Arequipa you can explore:

  • Colonial Historic Center
  • Plaza de Armas
  • Santa Catalina Monastery
  • Yanahuara and Carmen Alto viewpoints

Included in our Arequipa city tour experiences.

3. Colca Canyon: Nature at Its Finest

One of the deepest canyons in the world.

Perfect for:

  • Watching the Andean condor in flight
  • Enjoying dramatic landscapes
  • Visiting traditional villages
  • Relaxing in hot springs

Part of our Colca tour experiences.

4. Sillar Route: A Unique Experience in Arequipa

A different and lesser-known excursion.

Here you’ll discover:

  • Sillar stone quarries
  • Traditional extraction techniques
  • Impressive volcanic formations
  • Culebrillas Canyon with petroglyphs

Ideal for travelers seeking cultural experiences off the beaten path.

5. More Adventure in Cusco

If you want to return to the Cusco region but experience something new:

Explore:

  • Humantay Lake
  • Rainbow Mountain
  • Alternative hikes
  • The deeper Sacred Valley

6. Extend Your Trip to Salar de Uyuni

If you’re looking for an even more extraordinary experience:

Combine Peru with Bolivia and visit:

  • Train Cemetery
  • Colchani
  • Salt Eyes
  • Incahuasi Island
  • The incredible Salar de Uyuni

One of the most impressive extensions for repeat travelers.

Is It Worth Returning to Peru?

Absolutely.

Because Machu Picchu is not the end of the journey…

It’s only the beginning.

Peru has enough destinations for multiple completely different trips.

Plan Your Second Trip with Local Experts

At GT Peru Travel we help you design a completely different second experience in Peru:

  • Peruvian Coast
  • Arequipa and Colca
  • Adventures in Cusco
  • Bolivia Extensions

Discover the Peru that most travelers never get to see.

Contact us today and plan your next adventure beyond Machu Picchu.
